method: Actual rendered pages viewed at 1800x1013, not text-only.

pages.observation: Printed10. Agent/environment loop with action and next-state/reward arrows; episode described from start to terminal state. External collection boundary not explicitly a natural terminal state.
Printed11. Deterministic and stochastic policy notation; comparison box Sarsa on-policy, Q-learning off-policy. No explicit Sarsa numerical target.
Printed12. Finite undiscounted reward sum and infinite discounted sum; gamma0 immediate, approaching1 farsighted. Discounting physical-time rationale is qualified.
Printed13. Highest EXPECTED cumulative return; V*=max policy V and max action Q*. No guarantee for each realized trajectory.
Printed15. Bellman V*/Q* equations use immediate expected reward and discounted weighted successor values; true-Q* greedy policy.
Printed16. Exploration versus exploitation; source immediate-reward gloss conflicts with cumulative Q criterion.
Printed17. Model-free sampled TD, Q-learning/Sarsa versus known-model dynamic programming. Source strict model-based/no-exploration contrast needs qualification.
Printed18. Q increment eta*(r+gamma*max successor Q-old Q); target label what actually happened is incomplete because bootstrap is estimated. Convergence claim lacks full assumptions.
Printed19. Epsilon-greedy pseudocode: observe transition, update old entry, then advance; terminal masking omitted.
Printed20. Gripper location and target enter RL controller; reach target then close gripper. Reaching is not a stable grasp/collision-free guarantee.
Printed21. Text lists make, reset, step, render as key Gymnasium functions; common API and wrappers.
Printed23. Pip installation is a code block; FetchReachDense-v4, 7DOF, four-dimensional Cartesian/gripper action and negative-distance reward are prose/equation. Zero distance permits zero reward.
Printed24. Imports and register_envs precede gym.make. Registration is not instantiating every robot model.
Printed25. Eight bins per axis, width .04, six axis moves with fourth component zero; normalized action and discretization width have different roles.
Printed26. Q zeros, alpha .1 gamma .95 epsilon .5; desired-achieved error shifted .16, divided .04, integer conversion and clipping 0..7. Reset and 5000-episode loop.
Printed27. Fifty-step loop; exploration/argmax; step returns obs,r,terminated,truncated,info. Prose won/physics-engine timeout is not general API definition.
Printed28. Successor encode, TD update old state, then advance and accumulate, then termination/truncation break. Unconditional bootstrap needs terminal-scope qualification.
Printed29. Reward append, epsilon floor .05 and .998 decay; print every500 last100 mean. Unseeded output fluctuates and is not a deterministic promised trace.
Printed30. Convolution 50-window valid mean and plot. Curve rises about -9 toward -3/-4 with fluctuations; not zero-error/optimality proof.

Printed31. Prose bullets with inline literals: finer 12-bin grid, 20000 episodes, neural approximation, fourth gripper channel. No executable Python block. Claims eliminating dimensionality and grasping through fourth channel need qualification.
Printed32. Summary repeats RL delayed numerical rewards, true Q*, model-free off-policy Q-learning and example; no new numerical case.
